title: Environmental and human risk assessment of polymer nanocarriers: a review on current analytical challenges and promising approaches
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01033G, Critical Review
Dona Manayath, Jadranka Travas-Sejdic, Erin M. Leitao, Melanie Kah
Polymer nanocarriers are designed to deliver active ingredients in agricultural, food and pharmaceutical applications. It is essential to ensure their safety towards environmental and human health.
